headers.scanSteps_le:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    scanSteps e rs ≤ (rs.map fun r => r.eligibleEdges.length+3).sum+1
headers.steps_le_input:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    scanSteps e rs+(selected e rs).length+1 ≤ inputBound rs
headers.run_prepare:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    Controller.run (transition e) (inputBound rs) (.records rs [])=.halt (selected e rs)
headers.execute_eq:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    execute e rs=selected e rs
headers.execute_sublist:
(e : StoredEdges.Edge) (rs : List Record) :
    (execute e rs).Sublist rs
